newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Jan-May shipbuilding orders soar.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Jan-May shipbuilding orders soar.

text.p: South Korean shipyards won orders totalling 3.59 million gross tons for 58 ships in the first five months of this year, up from 1.47 million gross tons for 33 ships a year ago, shipbuilders said on Tuesday.

The Korea Shipbuilders' Association said all ships were for export. The association said ships completed in the five-month period totalled 2.63 million gross tons for 60 ships, against 2.81 million gross tons for 65 ships a year ago.
Backlogged orders at the end of May were 14.06 million gross tons (277 ships), compared with 12.95 million gross tons (274 ships) a year ago, the association said.
